# coding: utf-8
from pathlib import Path
import getpass,hashlib,json,os,platform,shlex,signal,socket,subprocess,sys,tempfile,time,traceback
root=Path('/Users/tenonsuzu/Documents/Codes/congminal');output=root/'docs/evaluations/m6-sftp-native-faults.json'
peer=r'''
import struct,sys
from pathlib import Path
mode=Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()
r=sys.stdin.buffer;w=sys.stdout.buffer
 def_unused=0
'''.replace(' def_unused=0','')+r'''
def exact(n):
 b=b''
 while len(b)<n:
  part=r.read(n-len(b))
  if not part:raise EOFError()
  b+=part
 return b
def packet():
 n=struct.unpack('>I',exact(4))[0]
 if n>65536:raise ValueError(n)
 return exact(n)
def send(body):w.write(struct.pack('>I',len(body))+body);w.flush()
try:
 assert packet()==b'\1\0\0\0\3'
 send(b'\2\0\0\0\3')
 p=packet();assert p[0]==11
 send(b'\x66'+p[1:5]+b'\0\0\0\1H')
 p=packet();assert p[0]==12
 if mode=='huge':w.write(struct.pack('>I',1<<30)+b'\x68'+p[1:5]);w.flush()
 elif mode=='name':send(b'\x68'+p[1:5]+struct.pack('>IIII',1,1<<30,0,0))
 elif mode=='close':sys.exit(0)
 r.read() # 故意无响应，直到客户端关闭独立连接；不遗留 sleep 子进程。
except EOFError:pass
'''
result={'scope':'Real isolated SSH subsystem returns deliberately malformed SFTP or stalls; C libssh2 uses actual congminal Rust NativePool callbacks with 8MiB shared Budget, 1MiB single-allocation cap. Nonblocking worker checks cancellation at 200ms then shutdown(SHUT_RDWR), closes handle, subsystem and session. Tests allocator and native API feasibility, not UI task cancellation or complete backend integration. with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='congminal-sftp-faults-')as temporary:
 base=Path(temporary);os.chmod(base,0o700)
 for key in ['host','client']:subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/ssh-keygen','-q','-t','ed25519','-N','','-f',str(base/key)],check=True)
 (base/'peer.py').write_text(peer);mode=base/'mode';mode.write_text('huge')
 sock=socket.socket();sock.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));port=sock.getsockname()[1];sock.close()
 config=f'''Port {port}
ListenAddress 127.0.0.1
HostKey {base}/host
PidFile {base}/pid
AuthorizedKeysFile {base}/client.pub
StrictModes no
PasswordAuthentication no
KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
UsePAM no
AllowUsers {getpass.getuser()}
AllowTcpForwarding no
X11Forwarding no
PermitTTY no
Subsystem sftp {shlex.quote(sys.executable)} {shlex.quote(str(base/'peer.py'))} {shlex.quote(str(mode))}
LogLevel ERROR
'''
 (base/'config').write_text(config);subprocess.run(['/usr/sbin/sshd','-t','-f',str(base/'config')],check=True)
 key=(base/'host.pub').read_text().split();(base/'known').write_text(f'[127.0.0.1]:{port} {key[0]} {key[1]}\n')
 with (base/'server.log').open('w')as log:
  server=subprocess.Popen(['/usr/sbin/sshd','-D','-e','-f',str(base/'config')],stdout=log,stderr=log,start_new_session=True)
  try:
   time.sleep(.2)
   assert server.poll()is None
   for scenario in ['huge','name','stall','close']:
    for i in range(5):
     mode.write_text(scenario)
     p=subprocess.run(['/tmp/congminal-sftp-fault-proto',str(port),getpass.getuser(),str(base/'client'),str(base/'known'),scenario],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5)
     result['runs'].append({'scenario':scenario,'round':i,'exit':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr})
     print(scenario,i,p.returncode,p.stdout.strip(),p.stderr.strip(),flush=True)
     assert p.returncode==0,result['runs'][-1]

     if scenario=='huge':assert 'denied=1' in p.stdout
  except Exception:result['failure']=traceback.format_exc();raise
